# Get all playlists from Spotify library (paginate)
sp_token = sp_login['access_token']
playlists = []
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=sp_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    playlists.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(f"Total playlists: {len(playlists)}")
for p in playlists:
    print(p['playlist_id'], p['title'])

steps.code:
# Parse the old songs list to extract song titles and artists
content = file_data['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
old_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artists
        if ' by ' in line:
            title, artists_str = line.split(' by ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            old_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})
print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs")
for s in old_songs:
    print(s)
